name: Tyke
caption: Held the ECW World Championship into a 24 June 1999 broadcast before losing it by submission to Thomas Lusty, after the challenger's cornerman turned on him mid-match.

tenures.style: Technical wrestler with strong cruiserweight background, also very fast paced

name: Thomas Lusty
caption: Won the ECW World Championship from Tyke on 24 June 1999 by submission, then was attacked and knocked out by a returning rival immediately after.

name: Carnage
